task.description:
Implement OIDC-09 (JIT user provisioning) per the design at src/design/oidc-09-jit-provisioning.md. The design covers:

1. Create src/oidc/jit_provisioning.zig with:
   - JitProvisioningConfig struct (realm, enabled, default_status, default_roles)
   - JitProvisioningResult struct (user: registry_mod.User, created: bool)
   - DEFAULT_JIT_CONFIG constant (enabled=true, status=ACTIVE, roles=[])
   - loadJitConfig(allocator, pool, realm) — loads per-realm config, returns defaults when no row exists
   - provisionFromIdentityContext(allocator, identity_service, pool, audit_writer, identity_ctx, realm_issuer, tenant_id) — orchestrates: load config, call createOrGetJitOidcUser, emit audit events, return result
   - syncAttributesFromIdentityContext(allocator, identity_service, pool, identity_ctx, tenant_id) — stub for OIDC-10 attribute synchronisation
   - JitProvisioningError error set, JitConfigError, SyncError

2. Create migration file NNN_jit_provisioning_config.sql:
   - CREATE TABLE jit_provisioning_config (realm TEXT PRIMARY KEY, enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, default_status TEXT DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK (...), default_roles JSONB DEFAULT '[]', created_at, updated_at)
   - Seed row for 'bpm-default' realm

3. Wire into auth middleware (src/api/middleware/auth.zig):
   - After OIDC token verification produces a VerifiedPrincipal, call claim_mapping.mapVerifiedClaims to produce IdentityContext
   - Then call jit_provisioning.provisionFromIdentityContext to create/get the local user
   - Use the local user's user_id (not principal.provider_subject) for AuthContext
   - Use a gated check: if JIT is enabled for the realm, use the new path; otherwise fall back to legacy (principal.provider_subject as user_id)
   - Load local role bindings after provisioning
   - Import the new jit_provisioning module

4. Verify: zig build exits 0, zig build test passes, no 'error set' warnings in stderr

5. Ensure all allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator

6. Commit and push to feature/WF02-oidc09-20260527
acceptance_criteria: zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' warnings in stderr
Migration applies cleanly against fresh DB
All allocating functions accept an allocator parameter
No SQL string interpolation of user data
JIT-provisioned users have auth_source = 'oidc' and external_id/external_realm populated
First auth creates exactly one local record; subsequent auth does not create duplicates
